title: SEARCH TEXT key passes unsanitized user input to Tantivy query parser
description: In lifecycle.rs handle_nntp_search(), SearchKey::Text produces: query_str = value.to_owned() — the raw value string with NO call to escape_tantivy_query(). Every other SearchKey (Subject, From, Body) wraps the value in a field:"..." phrase with escaping applied. Text silently passes attacker-controlled input directly to Tantivy's query parser, which can interpret operators like +, -, AND, OR, (, ), field: etc. A malicious client can craft queries that escape the intended newsgroup scope filter if search_in_group applies a newsgroup constraint using field-based query composition, or cause a Tantivy parse error surfaced as a 451. In the worst case (depending on how search_in_group composes queries) it enables query injection across newsgroup boundaries.
